buyAnItem.title: How buying works
buyAnItem.body:
Open an item and tap Buy. Check the price breakdown, pick where it should go and pay. The item is held for you for 30 minutes while you finish.

Right now checkout is a practice run. No card is asked for and no money moves. Everything around it works the way it will for real.

After you pay, follow your order under My orders or in the chat with the seller.

makeAnOffer.title: Making an offer
makeAnOffer.body:
Not sure about the price? Tap "Send your offer" on the item and send an offer lower than the listed price. You can send up to 15 offers a day, and one at a time in each chat.

The seller can accept, decline or answer with a new price. If nobody answers, the offer closes after 48 hours.

When an offer is accepted the item is held for you for 24 hours, so you can check out at the agreed price.

covered.title: What Coverage is
covered.body:
Coverage is a small fee added at checkout. You see it on its own line in the price breakdown, next to the item price and postage.

It goes towards keeping buying safe, including our team looking into a problem with an order. The name is a working name and may change.

bundles.title: Bundles
bundles.body:
Take several items from the same seller and get a discount, with postage paid once for the whole parcel. On an item page, the Bundle box shows the seller's steps. Tap Add to bundle to start one, then add more of their items with the + Bundle buttons.

A bar at the bottom tells you how many items you have, what you save and how many more you need for the next step. Tap View bundle to see it all, continue to checkout and pay for everything in one order. Items stay on sale for everyone until you check out.

If you sell, you can switch bundles off or choose your own steps in Settings, Bundles.

saveItems.title: Saving items and searches
saveItems.body:
Tap the bookmark on an item to save it. Saved items wait for you in Favourites, and you hear about it if the price drops or the item sells.

An item from a seller who is away can still be saved. You can also save a search, and we tell you when something new matches.

listAnItem.title: Listing an item
listAnItem.body:
Tap Sell, add your photos (the first one is the cover) and fill in the name, category, size, condition and price. Tap Post it to put the item on sale, or Keep as draft to finish later.

Everything you list, including drafts, reserved, sold and hidden items, lives on your Profile.

setYourPrice.title: Choosing your price
setYourPrice.body:
You choose the price. Selling is free, so when an item sells you earn the full item price, after any discount you gave.

Buyers pay a little on top for Coverage and postage. You can see what they will pay while you set the price.

When someone sends an offer you can accept it, decline it or answer with a new price.

buzz.title: Boosting a listing
buzz.body:
A boost moves one of your listings to the top of the feed, so more people see it for a while. Tap "Boost this listing" on an active listing. While the boost lasts the listing shows a "Boosted" badge.

Boosts are free for now.

getPaid.title: Getting paid
getPaid.body:
When the buyer confirms the item arrived, or 48 hours after it arrives, the money moves from pending to available in your Balance.

Your balance and withdrawals are pretend for now. No real money moves and nothing is sent to a bank.

awayMode.title: Away mode
awayMode.body:
Going away for a while? Open Settings, then Away mode, and switch it on. You can pick the day you are back, or leave it open and switch it off yourself.

While you are away your items are left out of Home and search, and nobody can buy them. People can still open an item, save it and message you.

Away mode ends by itself on your return date. You can also end it from the banner on your profile.

orderSteps.title: Following an order
orderSteps.body:
An order goes from Paid to On its way, then Arrived and Complete. Both of you see the same steps on the tracker card at the top of the chat.

Checkout is a practice run for now, so shipping and arrival are pretend too. Nothing real travels yet.

shipAnOrder.title: Shipping an order
shipAnOrder.body:
When someone buys your item, pack it and tap Mark as shipped. You have 5 days. If it is not shipped by then, the order is cancelled and the item goes back on sale.

You are paid once the buyer confirms the item, so keep the chat open in case they have a question.

receivedOrProblem.title: When your order arrives
receivedOrProblem.body:
Tap I received it when everything is right. If you do nothing, the order completes by itself 48 hours after it arrives.

If something is wrong, tap Open a dispute within 2 days of the parcel arriving and tell us what happened. Our team looks into it and writes back.

When the order is complete you can both leave a review.

cancelAnOrder.title: Cancelling an order
cancelAnOrder.body:
Until the parcel is shipped, the buyer or the seller can tap Cancel order on the order page and give a reason. The item goes back on sale.

A checkout that is not paid within 30 minutes cancels by itself. Once an order is shipped it cannot be cancelled, but you can still open a dispute.

profileAndSizes.title: Your profile, sizes and language
profileAndSizes.body:
Settings, Your profile is where you change your photo, name, bio and city.

Under Shopping preferences you can add your sizes and brands, so Home shows you more of what fits.

The Language row in Settings switches the whole app between English and Hebrew straight away.

signInAndFaceId.title: Signing in and Face ID
signInAndFaceId.body:
Settings, Sign in and safety lets you unlock the app with Face ID if your phone supports it, and shows where you are logged in. You can log out of other phones from there.

Forgot your password? On the log in screen ask for a reset. We email a 6 digit code, never a link.

We will never ask you for your password or a code in a chat.

inviteFriends.title: Inviting a friend
inviteFriends.body:
Everyone has their own invite code and link. Share yours, and when a friend joins with it you get a thank-you reward.

Your own code does not work on your own account.

closeAccount.title: Closing your account
closeAccount.body:
You can close your account under Settings, Your account, Close account. Your personal details are cleared and nobody can log in to it again.

Past orders and messages stay for the people on the other side. Finish any open orders first.

stayInside.title: Staying safe
stayInside.body:
Keep chatting and paying inside Yadii. We can only look into orders made in the app, so if someone asks you to pay or talk somewhere else, say no and report them.

Never share your password or a 6 digit code with anyone, including people who say they work for us.

If an offer looks too good to be true, it usually is. Check the photos and the seller's reviews first.

reportAndBlock.title: Reporting and blocking
reportAndBlock.body:
See something wrong on an item or a profile? Open the more menu and choose Report, then pick a reason. Our team takes a look, and the person is not told it was you.

To stop talking to someone, block them from their profile. You will not see each other's items and cannot message each other.
